info.title: Copilot Cost Management
info.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Cost Management API (Microsoft Graph beta). Read the tenant Copilot Credits balance, per-user and per-service consumption, and manage spending policies, governed services, threshold alerts and alert recipients.

get.description: Returns the tenant-wide Copilot Credits balance snapshot: purchased, consumed and remaining credits, one row per billing method (prepaid credits, pay-as-you-go). Values are in Copilot Credits, not currency.
Lists the spending policies that cap Copilot Credits consumption, with their monthly limit, per-user limit, billing methods and status. Supports filtering on status, displayName and createdDateTime.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter on status, displayName or createdDateTime (eq, ne, and, or). Example: status eq microsoft.graph.spendingPolicyStatus'enabled'

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: displayName or createdDateTime, optionally followed by asc or desc. Example: createdDateTime desc

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of policies to return per page.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Set to true to include the total number of matching policies.

post.description: Creates a spending policy (always created disabled). For a selected-groups policy, add at least one group afterwards with 'Add group to policy' so the service can enable it. Requires the Billing Administrator or Global Administrator role.

get.description: Gets one spending policy with its limits, billing methods, status and current ETag.

delete.description: Deletes a spending policy. The policy stops governing consumption.

patch.description: Updates the display name, monthly limit, per-user limit or billing methods of a spending policy. Only the supplied values change.

get.description: Lists the groups assigned to a selected-groups spending policy. Returns 404 for a tenant-wide (all users) policy.
Lists the reference links of the groups assigned to a selected-groups spending policy.

post.description: Assigns a Microsoft Entra group to a selected-groups spending policy. Linking the first group can enable a disabled policy.

delete.description: Removes a group from a selected-groups spending policy. Removing the last group is refused (409 lastAssignedGroup).

get.description: Lists the services governed (enabled) or excluded (disabled) by a spending policy, with the parent policy status and ETag.

post.description: Adds a service to a spending policy. Settings not in the request are preserved.

get.description: Gets the governance state of one service within a spending policy.

patch.description: Enables or disables a service within a spending policy. Setting state to disabled is how a service is removed. Disabling the last enabled service is refused (409 atLeastOneServiceRequired).

get.description: Gets the notify-only email threshold alert configuration of a spending policy. Returns 404 itemNotFound when no alert is configured.

delete.description: Turns alerting off and discards the alert configuration of a spending policy. Recipient references are kept.

patch.summary: Create or update policy alert settings
patch.description: Creates (first call) or updates the threshold alerts of a spending policy. Add at least one recipient before enabling alerts. Thresholds only notify; they do not change limits.

get.description: Lists the users notified when an alert threshold of a spending policy is crossed.
Lists the reference links of the alert recipients of a spending policy.

post.description: Adds a tenant user as a recipient of the threshold alerts of a spending policy.

delete.description: Removes a user from the alert recipients of a spending policy. Removing the last recipient while alerting is enabled is refused (400 alertRecipientsRequired).

get.description: Gets a user's month-to-date Copilot Credits consumption for every governed service: consumed and remaining credits, applicable limits, the selected spending policy, and whether the user can still consume (with the reason).
Lists a user's per-service balance rows (month-to-date consumption, limits, remaining credits, access decision). Filter on serviceId or isConsumptionAllowed.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter on serviceId (eq, in) or isConsumptionAllowed (eq), combined with and. Example: isConsumptionAllowed eq false

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: serviceId, optionally followed by asc or desc.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Upper bound of rows per page.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Set to true to include the total number of matching rows.

get.description: Gets one service's balance row for one user: month-to-date consumption, limits, remaining credits and why the user can or cannot consume it.

CostManagementQuantity.description: A quantity of Copilot Credits that is either limited to a value or unlimited.

value.title: Value
value.description: Numeric value in the stated unit. Absent when the quantity is unlimited. Zero permits no consumption.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the quantity, for example copilotCredit.

isUnlimited.title: Is unlimited
isUnlimited.description: True when the quantity is unlimited (added by the connector).

lastModifiedDateTime.title: Data last modified
lastModifiedDateTime.description: Last modification time of the source data behind this row.

BillingMethodBalance.description: Credit balance for one billing method.

purchasedQuantity.title: Purchased credits
purchasedQuantity.description: Credits purchased. Absent when there is no purchased pool (for example pay-as-you-go).

remainingQuantity.title: Remaining credits
remainingQuantity.description: Credits still available, as calculated by the service. Absent when there is no finite pool.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of every quantity in this row, for example copilotCredit.

billingMethodBalances.title: Billing method balances
billingMethodBalances.description: One balance row per billing method.

SpendingPolicy.description: A policy that caps Copilot Credits consumption for an audience. Limits apply per UTC calendar month.

policyType.title: Audience type
policyType.description: allUsers or selectedGroups (added by the connector).

displayName.title: Policy name
displayName.description: Display name of the spending policy.

billingMethods.title: Billing methods
billingMethods.description: How consumption is funded: notSpecified, prepaidCredits, payAsYouGo or a combination such as prepaidCredits,payAsYouGo.

lastModifiedDateTime.title: Last modified
lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the policy was last modified.

etag.title: ETag
etag.description: Current ETag of the policy, when returned by the service (added by the connector).

@odata.count.title: Total count
@odata.count.description: Total number of matching policies, when requested.

@odata.nextLink.title: Next link
@odata.nextLink.description: URL of the next page, when more results exist.

ServiceSetting.description: Governance state of one service within a spending policy.

serviceId.title: Service ID
serviceId.description: Key of the governed service category, for example cowork or workIQ.

state.title: State
state.description: enabled (governed by the policy) or disabled (excluded).

parentStatus.title: Policy status
parentStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the parent policy.

etag.title: ETag
etag.description: ETag returned by the last change, when present (added by the connector).

thresholdType.title: Threshold type
thresholdType.description: percentage or absolute (added by the connector).

value.title: Threshold value
value.description: Percentage of the limit (1-100) or absolute quantity.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of an absolute threshold, for example copilotCredit.

AlertSetting.description: Notify-only email threshold alert configuration of a spending policy.

etag.title: ETag
etag.description: ETag returned by the last change, when present (added by the connector).

userPrincipalName.title: User principal name
userPrincipalName.description: User principal name of the user.

@odata.id.title: Reference URL
@odata.id.description: Reference URL of the directory object.

id.title: Object ID
id.description: Object ID parsed from the reference URL (added by the connector).

UserServiceBalance.description: A user's month-to-date (UTC) balance for one service, with the access decision.

spendingPolicyId.title: Spending policy ID
spendingPolicyId.description: Spending policy selected for this service.

consumedQuantity.title: Consumed credits
consumedQuantity.description: Credits consumed month-to-date (UTC) for this service.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of consumedQuantity, for example copilotCredit.

isConsumptionAllowed.title: Consumption allowed
isConsumptionAllowed.description: Whether the user can currently consume the service.

@odata.count.title: Total count
@odata.count.description: Total number of matching rows, when requested.

@odata.nextLink.title: Next link
@odata.nextLink.description: URL of the next page, when more results exist.

serviceId.title: Service ID
serviceId.description: Service whose balance could not be evaluated.

policyConfigurationAsOfDateTime.title: Policy configuration as of
policyConfigurationAsOfDateTime.description: As-of time of the policy configuration used.

groupMembershipAsOfDateTime.title: Group membership as of
groupMembershipAsOfDateTime.description: As-of time of the group membership used.

usageAsOfDateTime.title: Usage as of
usageAsOfDateTime.description: As-of time of the usage data used.

UserBalance.description: A user's computed per-service consumption balance.

serviceBalances.title: Service balances
serviceBalances.description: Per-service balance rows. Empty when the user never consumed anything.

unevaluatedServices.title: Unevaluated services
unevaluatedServices.description: Services whose balance could not be evaluated (partial result when not empty).

policyType.description: selectedGroups: only members of the groups you add later. allUsers: every user in the tenant. Cannot be changed after creation.

displayName.description: 10-64 characters: letters, digits and spaces only.

periodLimit.description: Copilot Credits cap for the whole audience per UTC calendar month. Leave empty for unlimited.

perUserLimit.description: Copilot Credits cap per user per UTC calendar month. Leave empty for unlimited.

serviceIds.description: Comma-separated service IDs to govern, for example cowork,workIQ. At least one is required.

billingMethods.description: How consumption under this policy is funded. Defaults to notSpecified.

displayName.description: New display name (10-64 characters: letters, digits and spaces).

periodLimit.description: New Copilot Credits cap for the whole audience per UTC month.

periodLimitUnlimited.description: Set to true to make the monthly limit unlimited.

perUserLimit.description: New Copilot Credits cap per user per UTC month.

perUserLimitUnlimited.description: Set to true to make the per-user limit unlimited.

billingMethods.description: How consumption under this policy is funded.

serviceId.description: Key of the service category to add, for example researcherCritiqueAndCouncil.

state.description: enabled: governed by the policy. disabled: excluded.
enabled: governed by the policy. disabled: excluded (this is how a service is removed).

isEnabled.description: Enable or disable alerting. Enabling requires at least one recipient.

percentageThresholds.description: Comma-separated percentages of the limit (integers 1-100), for example 80,100.

absoluteThresholds.description: Comma-separated absolute Copilot Credits values, for example 5000,9000.

clearThresholds.description: Set to true to remove every threshold while keeping the configuration and its recipients.

groupId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the group to assign.

userId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the user to notify.

code.title: Inner error code
code.description: Workload-specific error code, for example lastAssignedGroup.

PolicyServiceId.name: serviceId
PolicyServiceId.description: Key of the governed service category, for example cowork or workIQ.

AssignedGroupId.name: groupId
AssignedGroupId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the group to remove.

RecipientId.name: recipientId
RecipientId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the recipient to remove.

UserId.name: userId
UserId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID (GUID) of the user.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag of the parent spending policy, for example W/"6". Leave empty: the connector reads the current ETag automatically.

Select.name: $select
Select.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

tags.name: Spending policies
tags.description: Policies that cap Copilot Credits consumption for an audience.

tags.name: Policy groups
tags.description: Group audience of a selected-groups policy.

tags.name: Service settings
tags.description: Services governed or excluded by a policy.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Notify-only threshold alerts and their recipients.
